nom: Kopari Beauty Ceramide & Retinol Dual-Core Eye Balm

segments.dry: Reviewers who describe dry or very dry under-eye skin report the balm feels hydrating and softens the area without irritation (e.g. reviews 9, 31, 39).
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who call their skin or eye area sensitive largely report no burning, tugging or reaction, including some who normally react to retinol (10, 22, 25, 26, 31, 36, 38, 75), though one reviewer with unspecified skin experienced burning strong enough to stop use (0).
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention being in their late 20s to 40s or focused on fine lines/wrinkles report visibly softer lines and a plumper, brighter look with continued use (28, 29, 36, 63, 64).

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using it for fine lines and wrinkles report visible softening or reduced prominence within one to two weeks (13, 28, 37, 39, 45, 64), with a few seeing no strong change in darkness or wrinkles despite otherwise liking it (6).
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe immediate and lasting hydration and softness under the eyes (9, 21, 24, 39, 40, 52, 77); one reviewer instead found it oily and ineffective, comparing it to a lip balm with no real benefit (1).
concerns.redness: Reviewers using retinol who had previously seen redness report none with this product (6, 41), though one reviewer experienced burning severe enough to stop use entirely (0).
concerns.barrier: A reviewer with compromised, unpredictable sensitive skin reports the balm left skin cleaner and smoother without buildup or irritation (26).
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer found the formula too oily for her preference and not worth the price (1), while several others explicitly note it absorbs without greasiness or residue (6, 35, 46, 58, 71).

aspects.libelle: Leaves a shiny finish under eyes

extraits.texte: It made my eyes burn so bad that after 2 attempts I will not be using again.
